title: VisionStatementItems
description: Shape of content.items for L1-vision-statement-generator. items carries META POINTS about vision.md, not the full document — the full narrative (executive summary paragraph, full problem/value-prop text, full roadmap descriptions) lives ONLY in the artifact, saved to s3 (blob storage). '_summary' fields are short distillations; regulatory_posture, north_star_metrics, and open_risks stay structurally full since those are already meta-level facts (statuses, ids, targets, relationships), not prose duplication. This agent RECONCILES three upstream inputs rather than summarizing them: every Amber/Red constraint_summaries entry MUST be covered by at least one open_risks entry's related_ids, with a roadmap dependency. Coverage, not 1:1 cardinality — two thematically related Amber constraints MAY be grouped into one combined open_risks entry rather than forced into separate ones; dropping a constraint entirely is the defect this exists to prevent, not the grouping itself. This cross-reference cannot be expressed as a JSON Schema constraint (it spans this agent's own upstream inputs, not just its own output shape) — it is checked by L1-vision-statement-generator-evaluator, not by schema validation alone.

summary.description: One short gloss line for orchestration/notification use — the full 3-5 sentence executive summary is written into vision.md, not duplicated here. Must be a condensation of the sections below — never introduce a claim that doesn't appear elsewhere in this document.

Short gloss of the single most decision-relevant insight — the full paragraph is in vision.md's Market Context section. Market analysis is an OPTIONAL upstream input: when none was available, this is exactly 'Not assessed — no market analysis available' with confidence 0 and traced_to 'none'. The key itself stays required so the absence is stated rather than silently omitted

traced_to.description: Which competitor_matrix entries or SWOT item ids this condenses, or 'none' when no market analysis was available

regulatory_posture.description: Already meta-level (statuses, ids, short mitigation gists) — kept structurally in full, not further shrunk, since statement-generator-evaluator's reconciliation coverage check depends on it

constraint_id.description: The CON-NN id from regulatory-feasibility-checker's output

mitigation_summary.description: Carried from the upstream constraint's own mitigation_summary — already short

north_star_metrics.description: Already compact structured facts (metric name + target) — kept in full

title.description: Short phase title — not prose, kept in full

description_summary.description: Short distillation — full phase description is in vision.md's Roadmap Outline section

resolves_risk.description: open_risks id this phase resolves or de-risks, if any

description_summary.description: Short distillation — full risk description is in vision.md's Open Risks Carried Forward section

source.description: regulatory = traces to a regulatory_posture Amber/Red constraint; market = traces to a market_context SWOT weakness/threat

related_ids.description: The CON-NN or ST/WK/OP/TH-NN id(s) this risk traces back to. An array, not a single id — thematically related constraints MAY be grouped into one combined risk rather than forced into separate entries.

summary.description: Short gloss — the full carried-forward text is in vision.md. Must not contradict the corresponding idea-brief item.
